narration.text: A civic nonprofit's records requests on Friday 9 October 2026: three appeals filed inside 90 days, one for a denial that came only by mail, an overdue request chased, a narrowing, a city search fee disputed, and two new requests, while a late appeal, requests inside 20 working days, a city appeal and a records service go unfiled. This is a chore for the records coordinator of a small civic nonprofit that publishes investigative reports, with a board policy that it files its own requests, pays no records service and appeals an adverse determination it still needs. On the bench, she found 9 of 9 eligible items, worth 9 dollars of the 9 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 15 traps, and she walked past 15. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 68 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
